podcast.body: "Disco and Moscow" was a seven-inch single released by the English punk band The Vibrators in the fall of 1980. This release coincided with a period when the Cold War was intensifying. The band is not known to have had any connections with the KGB or any other secret police organizations from the Soviet bloc. "West the vibrators, an English punk band with that seven-inch single called Disco and Moscow in the Stores in the fall of 1980, right at a time when the Cold War was really starting to heat up."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
